name: Raven-Code
description: A powerful coding agent that can write, run and debug code for one engineering task on this host, then report what it did. Use this agent for a fix, a small feature, a script, or a failing test. IMPORTANT: it edits your files for real and has nobody to ask, so put the acceptance criteria in the task.
owns: owns coding: writing, running or debugging code. Do not write the code yourself.
